## About this build

This is a build of the fork that continues the port after upstream v1.6.2. The native renderer is experimental, so you may run into problems with it: if you do, switch to the shadPS4 renderer (Insert > Performance > Renderer) and please open an issue with the run log.

The source is open (GPL). Upstream's releases, v1.6.2 and earlier, stay on [its releases page](https://github.com/hachi23/unicorn_overlord_pc/releases).
